- [AD Serpinb7 Glut_1 Has2os glutamatergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4304433) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A glutamatergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Eps8l2 (Mmus), C1ql2 (Mmus), Has2os (Mmus). It is distinguished from other AD Serpinb7 Glut cells by expression of Has2os. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a6, Slc17a7). These cells are located in the Thalamus, brain , in or close to the regions: Anterodorsal nucleus, stria medullaris . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:2613 AD Serpinb7 Glut_1."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

### Astro-TE NN_1 Jph4 astrocyte (Mmus) `http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4307041`
#### Removed
- [Astro-TE NN_1 Jph4 astrocyte (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4307041) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A astrocyte of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Myoc (Mmus), Sptbn2 (Mmus), Alpk1 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other Astro-TE NN_1 cells by expression of Myoc, Jph4, Alpk1. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Aldh1a1, Slc17a7). These cells are located in the Isocortex, brain . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:5221 Astro-TE NN_1."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) 
  - [database_cross_reference](http://www.geneontology.org/formats/oboInOwl#hasDbXref) "https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-06812-z"^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [CA2-FC-IG Glut_1 hippocampal CA1-3 neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4302219) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A hippocampal CA1-3 neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Lefty1 (Mmus), Tmem215 (Mmus), Fgf16 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other CA2-FC-IG Glut cells by expression of Slc9a4. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a7, Aldh1a1). These cells are located in the Hippocampal region , in or close to the regions: Field CA1, stratum oriens, Field CA1, pyramidal layer, Field CA3, stratum oriens . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:0399 CA2-FC-IG Glut_1."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) 
  - [database_cross_reference](http://www.geneontology.org/formats/oboInOwl#hasDbXref) "https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-06812-z"^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Gabra6 (Mmus), Lmx1a (Mmus), Rnf182 (Mmus). - [CBX MLI Megf11 Gaba_1 Chst9 molecular layer interneuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4307008) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A molecular layer interneuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Asgr1 (Mmus), Chst9 (Mmus), Spns2 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other CBX MLI Megf11 Gaba_1 cells by expression of Chst9, Spns2. It is GABAergic (inferred from expression of Gad1, Gad2, Slc32a1). These cells are located in the Cerebellum, brain , in or close to the regions: Simple lobule . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:5188 CBX MLI Megf11 Gaba_1."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [CBX Purkinje Gaba_2 Sphk1 Purkinje cell (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4307016) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A Purkinje cell of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Pcp2 (Mmus), Slc9a3 (Mmus), Grin2a (Mmus). It is distinguished from other CBX Purkinje Gaba_2 cells by expression of Sphk1. It is GABAergic (inferred from expression of Gad1, Gad2, Slc32a1). These cells are located in the Cerebellum , in or close to the regions: Simple lobule, Crus 2, brain . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:5196 CBX Purkinje Gaba_2."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

### CHOR NN_1 Slc17a8 choroid plexus epithelial cell (Mmus) `http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4307085`
#### Removed
- [CHOR NN_1 Slc17a8 choroid plexus epithelial cell (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4307085) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A choroid plexus epithelial cell of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of 2900040C04Rik (Mmus), Slc17a8 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other CHOR NN cells by expression of Slc17a8. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a8). These cells are located in the brain , in or close to the regions: choroid plexus, lateral ventricle . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:5265 CHOR NN_1."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [CS-RPO Meis2 Gaba_5 Gal GABAergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4306449) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A GABAergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Ghrh (Mmus), Cdh23 (Mmus), Otp (Mmus). It is distinguished from other CS-RPO Meis2 Gaba_5 cells by expression of Gal. It is GABAergic (inferred from expression of Gad2, Gad1, Slc32a1, Th). These cells are located in the Pons , in or close to the regions: Nucleus raphe pontis, Tegmental reticular nucleus, Superior central nucleus raphe . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:4629 CS-RPO Meis2 Gaba_5."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

### DCO Il22 Gly-Gaba_2 cerebellum-like structure GABAergic neuron (Mmus) `http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4306992`

It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Il22 (Mmus), Edaradd (Mmus). It is distinguished from other DCO Il22 Gly-Gaba cells by expression of Ppp1r17. Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:5172 DCO Il22 Gly-Gaba_2."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [DTN-LDT-IPN Otp Pax3 Gaba_5 Celsr1 GABAergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4306615) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A GABAergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Pla2g2f (Mmus), Celsr1 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other DTN-LDT-IPN Otp Pax3 Gaba_5 cells by expression of Celsr1. It is GABAergic (inferred from expression of Gad1, Gad2, Slc32a1, Th). These cells are located in the Midbrain , in or close to the regions: Interpeduncular nucleus, rostral, Interpeduncular nucleus, caudal . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:4795 DTN-LDT-IPN Otp Pax3 Gaba_5."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [DTN-LDT-IPN Otp Pax3 Gaba_5 Tpbgl GABAergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4306619) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A GABAergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Gulo (Mmus), Pla2g2f (Mmus), Kcng4 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other DTN-LDT-IPN Otp Pax3 Gaba_5 cells by expression of Tpbgl. It is GABAergic (inferred from expression of Gad1, Gad2, Slc32a1, Th). These cells are located in the Hypothalamus, Midbrain , in or close to the regions: Supramammillary nucleus, Medial mammillary nucleus, dorsal part, Interpeduncular nucleus, rostral . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:4799 DTN-LDT-IPN Otp Pax3 Gaba_5."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [HPF CR Glut_1 Rspo3 Cajal-Retzius cell (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4302317) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A Cajal-Retzius cell of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Trp73 (Mmus), Shisal2b (Mmus), Creb5 (Mmus), Gdf5 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other HPF CR Glut cells by expression of Rspo3, Cdkn1c. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a6). These cells are located in the Hippocampal region, Retrohippocampal region, brain , in or close to the regions: Dentate gyrus, molecular layer, Field CA1, stratum lacunosum-moleculare . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:0497 HPF CR Glut_1."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [IT AON-TT-DP Glut_3 Pnmt intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4301997) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A intratelencephalic-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Pnmt (Mmus), Abi3bp (Mmus), Tfap2d (Mmus). It is distinguished from other IT AON-TT-DP Glut_3 cells by expression of Pnmt. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a7, Slc17a6). These cells are located in the Olfactory areas , in or close to the regions: Anterior olfactory nucleus, Main olfactory bulb, granule layer . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:0177 IT AON-TT-DP Glut_3."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [L2 IT ENT-po Glut_4 L2 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4302011) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A L2 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Tmem255b (Mmus), Cpa6 (Mmus), Gpr101 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other L2 IT ENT-po Glut cells by expression of Igfbp6. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a7, Slc17a6). These cells are located in the Retrohippocampal region , in or close to the regions: Entorhinal area, medial part, dorsal zone, layer 1, Entorhinal area, medial part, dorsal zone, layer 2, Entorhinal area, medial part, dorsal zone, layer 3, Entorhinal area, medial part, dorsal zone, layer 5 . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:0191 L2 IT ENT-po Glut_4."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [L2 IT PPP-APr Glut_3 Trpv6 L2 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4302146) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A L2 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Teddm3 (Mmus), Smoc2 (Mmus), Rmst (Mmus), Galr1 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other L2 IT PPP-APr Glut_3 cells by expression of Trpv6, Pcdh17. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a7, Slc17a6). These cells are located in the Hippocampal region, Retrohippocampal region , in or close to the regions: Postsubiculum, Dentate gyrus, molecular layer, Presubiculum . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:0326 L2 IT PPP-APr Glut_3."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

(2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:0342 L2/3 IT RSP Glut_1."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [L4 RSP-ACA Glut_1 Pvalb cerebral cortex neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4302168) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A cerebral cortex neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Scnn1a (Mmus), Cbln1 (Mmus), Vsig2 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other L4 RSP-ACA Glut cells by expression of Pvalb. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a7). These cells are located in the Isocortex , in or close to the regions: Retrosplenial area, ventral part, layer 2/3, Retrosplenial area, ventral part, layer 5 . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:0348 L4 RSP-ACA Glut_1."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [L6 CT CTX Glut_4 L6b glutamatergic cortical neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4302270) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A L6b glutamatergic cortical neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Urah (Mmus), Cdh9 (Mmus), Adamts1 (Mmus), Ano3 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other L6 CT CTX Glut cells by expression of Adamts1. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a7). These cells are located in the Isocortex , in or close to the regions: Retrosplenial area, ventral part, layer 6a, Retrosplenial area, ventral part, layer 5 . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:0450 L6 CT CTX Glut_4."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [LDT-PCG St18 Gaba_1 Rspo2 GABAergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4306585) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A GABAergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Otp (Mmus), Crhbp (Mmus), Rspo2 (Mmus), Dlk1 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other LDT-PCG St18 Gaba_1 cells by expression of Rspo2, Dlk1. It is GABAergic (inferred from expression of Gad2, Slc32a1, Gad1). These cells are located in the Midbrain, Pons , in or close to the regions: Laterodorsal tegmental nucleus, Periaqueductal gray, Pontine central gray . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:4765 LDT-PCG St18 Gaba_1."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [LHA-AHN-PVH Otp Trh Glut_4 Pappa2 glutamatergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4304158) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A glutamatergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Sim2 (Mmus), Pappa2 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other LHA-AHN-PVH Otp Trh Glut_4 cells by expression of Pappa2. - [MB-MY Tph2 Glut-Sero_1 Trh serotonergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4305705) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A serotonergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Slc6a4 (Mmus), Trh (Mmus), En1 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other MB-MY Tph2 Glut-Sero_1 cells by expression of Trh, En1. It is serotonergic (inferred from expression of Ddc, Slc6a4, Tph2, Slc18a2, Gad2, Gad1). These cells are located in the Midbrain, Pons , in or close to the regions: Laterodorsal tegmental nucleus, Periaqueductal gray . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:3885 MB-MY Tph2 Glut-Sero_1."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [MB-MY Tph2 Glut-Sero_6 serotonergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4305730) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A serotonergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Slc6a4 (Mmus), Tecrl (Mmus). It is distinguished from other MB-HB Sero cells by expression of Tecrl. It is serotonergic (inferred from expression of Ddc, Slc6a4, Tph2, Slc18a2, Slc17a8). These cells are located in the Pons , in or close to the regions: Superior central nucleus raphe, Dorsal tegmental nucleus, Pontine central gray . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:3910 MB-MY Tph2 Glut-Sero_6."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) 
  - [database_cross_reference](http://www.geneontology.org/formats/oboInOwl#hasDbXref) "https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-06808-9"^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [MB-MY Tph2 Glut-Sero_6 serotonergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4305730) [comment](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#comment) "Rationale for assigning this type to reference data: Assigned by automated classification (ELK) of a definition built from soma location Pons (P; &ge;80% of grey-matter cells in both the Yao 2023 and Zhuang 2023 MERFISH atlases) and neurotransmitter serotonin (all clusters) against CL 2026-06-08. Basis: NT. Other inferred CL parents: central nervous system neuron. [WMBO CL promotion round 1, 2026-10-13] Location is inferred from registration of MerFish Data. Registration may be inaccurate, giving misleading location to adjacent anatomical regions. Warning: This type MB-MY Tph2 Glut-Sero_6 does not have cells in any of the regions it is named for midbrain (MB), medulla (MY). The name merely indicates that it is a subtype of more general transcriptomic type that does. This assertion is based on data from registration to a reference standard common co-ordinate framework and parcelation scheme."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [MB-MY Tph2 Glut-Sero_7 serotonergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4305731) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A serotonergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Slc6a4 (Mmus), Gpr39 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other MB-HB Sero cells by expression of Piezo2, Tph1. It is serotonergic (inferred from expression of Ddc, Slc6a4, Tph2, Slc18a2, Slc17a8). These cells are located in the Pons , in or close to the regions: Nucleus raphe pontis, Superior central nucleus raphe . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:3911 MB-MY Tph2 Glut-Sero_7."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) 
  - [database_cross_reference](http://www.geneontology.org/formats/oboInOwl#hasDbXref) "https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-06808-9"^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [MB-MY Tph2 Glut-Sero_7 serotonergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4305731) [comment](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#comment) "Rationale for assigning this type to reference data: Assigned by automated classification (ELK) of a definition built from soma location Pons (P; &ge;80% of grey-matter cells in both the Yao 2023 and Zhuang 2023 MERFISH atlases) and neurotransmitter serotonin (all clusters) against CL 2026-06-08. Basis: NT. Other inferred CL parents: central nervous system neuron. [WMBO CL promotion round 1, 2026-10-13] Location is inferred from registration of MerFish Data. Registration may be inaccurate, giving misleading location to adjacent anatomical regions. Warning: This type MB-MY Tph2 Glut-Sero_7 does not have cells in any of the regions it is named for midbrain (MB), medulla (MY). The name merely indicates that it is a subtype of more general transcriptomic type that does. This assertion is based on data from registration to a reference standard common co-ordinate framework and parcelation scheme."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [MV-SPIV-PRP Dmbx1 Gly-Gaba_2 Slc6a2 GABAergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4306767) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A GABAergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. - [OB Dopa-Gaba_3 cerebral cortex neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4302411) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A cerebral cortex neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Frmd7 (Mmus), Tnni1 (Mmus), Slc17a8 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other OB Dopa-Gaba cells by expression of Slc17a8. It is glutamatergic and GABAergic (inferred from expression of Gad1, Gad2, Slc32a1, Slc17a8). These cells are located in the Olfactory areas, brain , in or close to the regions: olfactory nerve layer of main olfactory bulb, Main olfactory bulb . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:0591 OB Dopa-Gaba_3."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) 
  - [database_cross_reference](http://www.geneontology.org/formats/oboInOwl#hasDbXref) "https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-06812-z"^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [OB Eomes Ms4a15 Glut_1 Mustn1 cerebral cortex neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4302307) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A cerebral cortex neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Tfap2c (Mmus), Mustn1 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other OB Eomes Ms4a15 Glut_1 cells by expression of Mustn1. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a7, Slc17a6). These cells are located in the Olfactory areas, brain , in or close to the regions: Main olfactory bulb, outer plexiform layer, Main olfactory bulb . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:0487 OB Eomes Ms4a15 Glut_1."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [OB Eomes Ms4a15 Glut_4 cerebral cortex neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4302314) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A cerebral cortex neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Ms4a15 (Mmus), Vdr (Mmus). It is distinguished from other OB Eomes Ms4a15 Glut cells by expression of Vdr. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a7). These cells are located in the Olfactory areas, brain , in or close to the regions: olfactory nerve layer of main olfactory bulb, Main olfactory bulb, outer plexiform layer, Main olfactory bulb . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:0494 OB Eomes Ms4a15 Glut_4."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [OB Meis2 Thsd7b Gaba_1 Chst9 cerebral cortex neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4302340) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A cerebral cortex neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Mdfic (Mmus), Colq (Mmus), Cbln2 (Mmus), Chst9 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other OB Meis2 Thsd7b Gaba_1 cells by expression of Chst9, Colq. It is GABAergic (inferred from expression of Gad1, Gad2, Slc32a1). These cells are located in the Olfactory areas, brain , in or close to the regions: olfactory nerve layer of main olfactory bulb, Main olfactory bulb . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:0520 OB Meis2 Thsd7b Gaba_1."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [OB Meis2 Thsd7b Gaba_3 cerebral cortex neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4302345) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A cerebral cortex neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of 4930523C07Rik (Mmus), Gm38505 (Mmus), Hmcn1 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other OB Meis2 Thsd7b Gaba cells by expression of Atp6v1c2. It is GABAergic (inferred from expression of Gad1, Gad2, Slc32a1). These cells are located in the Olfactory areas , in or close to the regions: Main olfactory bulb, mitral layer, Accessory olfactory bulb, mitral layer, Accessory olfactory bulb, glomerular layer, Main olfactory bulb, outer plexiform layer, Main olfactory bulb, granule layer . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:0525 OB Meis2 Thsd7b Gaba_3."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [OB Trdn Gaba_1 GABAergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4302349) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A GABAergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Trdn (Mmus), Slc12a8 (Mmus), Cpa6 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other OB Trdn Gaba cells by expression of Grik1. It is GABAergic (inferred from expression of Gad1, Slc32a1). These cells are located in the Olfactory areas, brain , in or close to the regions: Main olfactory bulb, granule layer, Main olfactory bulb, outer plexiform layer . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:0529 OB Trdn Gaba_1."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [PAG Pou4f1 Ebf2 Glut_3 Chrnb3 glutamatergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4304943) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A glutamatergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other PAG Pou4f1 Ebf2 Glut_3 cells by expression of Sox6, Chrnb3. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a6). Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:3123 PAG Pou4f1 Ebf2 Glut_3."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [PAL-STR Gaba-Chol_1 Rxfp1 GABA-Chol neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4302747) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A GABA-Chol neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Slc18a3 (Mmus), Dsg1a (Mmus), Gbx1 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other PAL-STR Gaba-Chol_1 cells by expression of Rxfp1. It is cholinergic (inferred from expression of Chat, Slc18a3, Slc18a2, Slc17a8, Gad2, Gad1). These cells are located in the Pallidum, brain , in or close to the regions: Globus pallidus, external segment, Substantia innominata, Diagonal band nucleus, internal capsule . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:0927 PAL-STR Gaba-Chol_1."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [PRNc Prox1 Brs3 Gly-Gaba GABA-Gly neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4306489) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A GABA-Gly neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Brs3 (Mmus), Hmcn1 (Mmus), Meis2 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other P GABA cells by expression of Brs3, Hmcn1, Meis2. It is GABAergic and glycinergic (inferred from expression of Gad2, Gad1, Slc32a1, Slc6a5). These cells are located in the Medulla, Pons , in or close to the regions: Pontine reticular nucleus, caudal part, Intermediate reticular nucleus . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:4669 PRNc Prox1 Brs3 Gly-Gaba_1."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [PRNc-NI-SG-RPO Vsx2 Nr4a2 Glut_2 Pdgfd glutamatergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4305949) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A glutamatergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Vsx2 (Mmus), Frem3 (Mmus), Pnoc (Mmus), Skor1 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other PRNc-NI-SG-RPO Vsx2 Nr4a2 Glut_2 cells by expression of Pdgfd, Pnoc, Skor1. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a6, Th). These cells are located in the Pons , in or close to the regions: Abducens nucleus, Superior central nucleus raphe, Pontine central gray . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:4129 PRNc-NI-SG-RPO Vsx2 Nr4a2 Glut_2."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [PRNc-NI-SG-RPO Vsx2 Nr4a2 Glut_3 Adamts19 glutamatergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4305952) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A glutamatergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Vsx2 (Mmus), Gm32828 (Mmus), Nppc (Mmus). It is distinguished from other PRNc-NI-SG-RPO Vsx2 Nr4a2 Glut_3 cells by expression of Adamts19. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a6, Gad2). These cells are located in the Pons , in or close to the regions: Pontine reticular nucleus, caudal part, Pontine reticular nucleus, Tegmental reticular nucleus, Superior central nucleus raphe . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:4132 PRNc-NI-SG-RPO Vsx2 Nr4a2 Glut_3."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [PVH-SO-PVa Otp Glut_5 Rxfp2 glutamatergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4304203) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A glutamatergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Lta (Mmus), Otp (Mmus). It is distinguished from other PVH-SO-PVa Otp Glut_5 cells by expression of Rxfp2. - [SC Bnc2 Glut_3 Prom1 glutamatergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4305027) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A glutamatergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Them7 (Mmus), Bnc2 (Mmus), Npffr2 (Mmus), Plpp4 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other SC Bnc2 Glut_3 cells by expression of Prom1. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a6). These cells are located in the Midbrain , in or close to the regions: Superior colliculus, zonal layer, Superior colliculus, superficial gray layer, Superior colliculus, optic layer . It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Pax7 (Mmus), Tiam2 (Mmus), Pappa (Mmus), Npffr1 (Mmus). Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. - [SC Otx2 Gcnt4 Gaba_2 GABAergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4305492) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A GABAergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Pax7 (Mmus), Samsn1 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other SC Otx2 Gcnt4 Gaba cells by expression of Cdhr1. It is GABAergic (inferred from expression of Gad2, Gad1, Slc32a1). These cells are located in the Midbrain , in or close to the regions: Inferior colliculus, dorsal nucleus, Superior colliculus, zonal layer, Superior colliculus, superficial gray layer, brain . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:3672 SC Otx2 Gcnt4 Gaba_2."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [SC Tnnt1 Gli3 Gaba_1 Gm38505 GABAergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4305601) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A GABAergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Tnnt1 (Mmus), Gli3 (Mmus), Trpc4 (Mmus), Grm8 (Mmus). These cells are located in the Midbrain , in or close to the regions: Superior colliculus, motor related, intermediate gray layer, Superior colliculus, motor related, intermediate white layer, Inferior colliculus, dorsal nucleus . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:3781 SC Tnnt1 Gli3 Gaba_1."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [SC-PAG Lef1 Emx2 Gaba_3 Mob3b GABAergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4305514) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A GABAergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Pax7 (Mmus), Bmpr1b (Mmus), Lncenc1 (Mmus), Pou6f2 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other SC-PAG Lef1 Emx2 Gaba_3 cells by expression of Mob3b. It is GABAergic (inferred from expression of Gad2, Gad1, Slc32a1). These cells are located in the Midbrain , in or close to the regions: Midbrain reticular nucleus, Superior colliculus, motor related, deep gray layer, Inferior colliculus, dorsal nucleus . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:3694 SC-PAG Lef1 Emx2 Gaba_3."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [SC-PAG Lef1 Emx2 Gaba_3 Sox6 GABAergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4305512) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A GABAergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of E330013P04Rik (Mmus), Sox6 (Mmus), Tfap2b (Mmus). It is distinguished from other SC-PAG Lef1 Emx2 Gaba_3 cells by expression of Sox6. It is GABAergic (inferred from expression of Gad2, Gad1, Slc32a1). These cells are located in the Midbrain , in or close to the regions: Superior colliculus, motor related, intermediate gray layer, Superior colliculus, motor related, intermediate white layer, Superior colliculus, motor related, deep gray layer . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:3692 SC-PAG Lef1 Emx2 Gaba_3."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [SCig Foxb1 Otx2 Glut_1 Npsr1 glutamatergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4305073) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A glutamatergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Foxb1 (Mmus), Otx2os1 (Mmus), Npsr1 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other SCig Foxb1 Otx2 Glut cells by expression of Npsr1. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a6). These cells are located in the Midbrain , in or close to the regions: Superior colliculus, motor related, intermediate gray layer, Superior colliculus, motor related, intermediate white layer, Inferior colliculus, dorsal nucleus . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:3253 SCig Foxb1 Otx2 Glut_1."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [SCs Pax7 Nfia Gaba_3 Syt10 GABAergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4305576) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A GABAergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Pax7 (Mmus), Qrfpr (Mmus), Irx3 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other SCs Pax7 Nfia Gaba_3 cells by expression of Syt10. It is GABAergic (inferred from expression of Gad2, Gad1, Slc32a1). These cells are located in the Midbrain , in or close to the regions: Superior colliculus, superficial gray layer, Superior colliculus, optic layer . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:3756 SCs Pax7 Nfia Gaba_3."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [SCsg Gabrr2 Gaba_3 Ndnf GABAergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4305635) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A GABAergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Pax7 (Mmus), Gm38505 (Mmus), Ndnf (Mmus). It is distinguished from other SCsg Gabrr2 Gaba_3 cells by expression of Ndnf. It is GABAergic (inferred from expression of Gad1, Gad2, Slc32a1). These cells are located in the Midbrain , in or close to the regions: Inferior colliculus, dorsal nucleus, Superior colliculus, zonal layer, Superior colliculus, superficial gray layer, Superior colliculus, optic layer . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:3815 SCsg Gabrr2 Gaba_3."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [STN-PSTN Pitx2 Glut_7 glutamatergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4304279) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A glutamatergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Pirt (Mmus), Pitx2 (Mmus), Crhbp (Mmus). It is distinguished from other STN-PSTN Pitx2 Glut cells by expression of Pirt. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a6). These cells are located in the Hypothalamus , in or close to the regions: Lateral hypothalamic area, Medial mammillary nucleus, dorsal part, Posterior hypothalamic nucleus, Medial mammillary nucleus, lateral part, Supramammillary nucleus . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:2459 STN-PSTN Pitx2 Glut_7."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [STR D1 Gaba_3 Ddit4l direct pathway medium spiny neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4302770) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A direct pathway medium spiny neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Sh3rf2 (Mmus), Ddit4l (Mmus), Tac1 (Mmus), Rgs14 (Mmus). - [TMv-PMv Tbx3 Hist-Gaba_1 Crhbp histaminergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4303396) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A histaminergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Hdc (Mmus), Ccn5 (Mmus), Dsp (Mmus). It is distinguished from other TMv-PMv Tbx3 Hist-Gaba_1 cells by expression of Crhbp. - [VCO Mafa Meis2 Glut_2 glutamatergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4306381) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A glutamatergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Fshr (Mmus), 2610307P16Rik (Mmus). It is distinguished from other VCO Mafa Meis2 Glut cells by expression of Calb1. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a7, Slc17a6). These cells are located in the Medulla, Cerebellum , in or close to the regions: Ventral cochlear nucleus, Flocculus . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. (2023), Whole Mouse Brain in cell set Cluster:4561 VCO Mafa Meis2 Glut_2."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [VCO Mafa Meis2 Glut_3 Tspan10 glutamatergic neuron (Mmus)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4306382) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A glutamatergic neuron of the Mus musculus brain. It is distinguished from other cells in the brain by selective expression of Lrrc52 (Mmus), Tspan10 (Mmus). It is distinguished from other VCO Mafa Meis2 Glut_3 cells by expression of Tspan10. It is glutamatergic (inferred from expression of Slc17a6, Slc17a7). These cells are located in the Medulla, Cerebellum , in or close to the regions: Ventral cochlear nucleus, Flocculus . Reference transcriptomic data for this type can be found in the dataset/taxonomy - Yao et al. - [bone marrow adipocyte](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0020083) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "An adipocyte that is part of bone marrow, constituting a distinct adipose depot from white, brown, and beige adipocytes [PMID:28872979]. Bone marrow adipocytes reside within the hypoxic marrow space close to the endosteal surface and adjacent to the microvascular space, where they store and release energy, secrete adipokines including adiponectin, and interact with neighboring bone cells and hematopoietic stem cells via paracrine and endocrine signaling [PMID:31702948, PMID:24998914]. They support hematopoiesis and suppress bone formation at steady state, and serve as an energy reservoir during metabolic stress; unlike white adipose tissue, bone marrow adipose tissue expands during caloric restriction, aging, anorexia nervosa, and irradiation [PMID:37315208, PMID:37587198, PMID:24998914]."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [epithelial cell of mesonephric duct](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0020121) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A duct epithelial cell that is part of the mesonephric (Wolffian) duct, an embryonic structure derived from the intermediate mesoderm. These epithelial cells differentiate from nephric duct progenitors during early urinary and reproductive tract development, form the lining of the mesonephric duct, and give rise to distinct anterior-posterior epithelial subtypes developmentally related to nephron and reproductive tract structures. Canonical markers include PAX2 (supported in mouse, human, rat, catshark, and mouse stem cell models) and LHX1 (Lim1; supported in mouse and human, often co-expressed with PAX2 in mesonephric epithelium) [PMID:37953493, PMID:42361159, PMID:25693193]; Cdh1, Cdh16, Hnf1b, Atp1a1, Nphs2, and Foxi1 are strongly supported as canonical markers in Xenopus laevis mesonephric duct epithelium, with Cdh1 also supported as an epithelial marker in mouse [PMID:39868253]."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [gut secretory progenitor cell](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0019044) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A gut epithelial progenitor cell that is committed to the secretory lineage rather than the absorptive lineage, giving rise to goblet, Paneth and enteroendocrine cells, and remaining proliferative. Commitment is driven by the transcription factor ATOH1, which specifies secretory over absorptive fate from the crypt progenitor pool (Lin et al., 2022). In mouse, these cells are marked by strong upregulation of the Notch ligand DLL1 in immediate stem cell daughters (van Es et al., 2012); in human, they express ATOH1 together with early secretory markers including TFF3, CLCA1, KLK1, HEPACAM2, ANXA13 and PHLDA2, and overlap transcriptionally with the transit-amplifying compartment and with nascent goblet cells."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) 
  - [database_cross_reference](http://www.geneontology.org/formats/oboInOwl#hasDbXref) "PMID:35081371"^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) 

  - [database_cross_reference](http://www.geneontology.org/formats/oboInOwl#hasDbXref) "PMID:23000963"^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [hippocampal trilaminar cell](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0020077) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A GABAergic interneuron of hippocampal CA1, with soma at the stratum oriens/alveus border. Its dendrites are largely confined to stratum oriens while its local axon distributes across strata oriens, pyramidale and radiatum - the arrangement for which the type is named - and it additionally projects to the subiculum. It expresses a high level of somato-dendritic muscarinic M2 acetylcholine receptor and lacks somatostatin, parvalbumin, vasoactive intestinal peptide, neuropeptide Y and calbindin. Its presynaptic inputs are unusually densely decorated with mGluR8a-containing terminals. Output synapses are strongly biased toward other interneurons, including parvalbumin-expressing cells, while also contacting pyramidal cell somata. Firing falls during movement and rises in prolonged bursts above 200 Hz during slow-wave sleep."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [immature intestinal tuft cell](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0019047) [comment](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#comment) "The developmental origin of the tuft lineage is unresolved. Tuft cells were originally defined as an ATOH1-dependent secretory cell type (Gerbe et al., 2011), but subsequent work reported ATOH1-independent differentiation toward tuft and enteroendocrine fates via SOX4 (Gracz et al., 2018), and trajectory analysis suggested distinct tuft cell origins in small intestine and colon (Herring et al., 2018). The 'directly develops from' axiom here follows the Human Gut Cell Atlas, which places this state between secretory progenitors and mature tuft cells."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [interneuron (sensu lato)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0000099) [comment](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#comment) "'Sensu lato' means 'in the broad sense'; it is not a taxon restriction. Elsewhere in CL, 'sensu' is used only with taxa (e.g. 'CNS neuron (sensu Vertebrata)'). Usage of 'interneuron' differs between fields. (1) In invertebrate neurobiology and in general textbooks, an interneuron is any neuron that is neither sensory nor motor; this includes projection neurons (e.g. insect antennal lobe projection neurons, 'projection/relay interneurons') as well as local neurons. (2) In the vertebrate spinal cord, interneurons are neurons whose axons stay within the spinal cord, including long-range commissural and propriospinal neurons, as opposed to motor neurons and ascending tract (projection) neurons. (3) In the enteric nervous system, interneurons are neurons that are neither intrinsic primary afferent neurons nor motor neurons; many project long distances along the gut. Similar usage ('local circuit neuron') applies to intrinsic cardiac and other intramural ganglia. (4) In the vertebrate brain and retina, 'interneuron' usually means a local circuit neuron whose axon stays within the region that contains its soma, as opposed to that region's projection (principal) neurons; for this sense use 'local interneuron' (CL:0004001). All four usages follow one pattern: an interneuron of a structure has its soma and axon within that structure. They differ in which structure is meant: the whole nervous system, the spinal cord, the enteric nervous system, or a brain region. This class covers all of these senses; 'local interneuron' and 'projection neuron' are subclasses of it."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) 

- [interneuron (sensu lato)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0000099) [label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "interneuron (sensu lato)"^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) 

- [interneuron (sensu lato)](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0000099) SubClassOf [neuron](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0000540)

This cell senses luminal stimuli via taste receptors and succinate signalling, initiating type 2 immune responses through the secretion of interleukin-25 while modulating epithelial regeneration through prostaglandin synthesis. - [projection neuron](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0020139) [comment](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#comment) "In CL, projection neuron is restricted to interneurons (sensu lato). Sensory neurons and efferent neurons (motor, preganglionic autonomic and neurosecretory neurons) also have long axons and are included in some uses of the term, e.g. Golgi type I neuron; they are classified under afferent or efferent neuron instead. In developmental and transcriptomic usage, 'projection neuron' often names pallial glutamatergic (pyramidal-lineage) neurons as a class (see glutamatergic projection neuron); CL classification follows axonal projection, not lineage. Neurons with both local and long-range axons are projection neurons."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [sst chodl GABAergic interneuron](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_4023121) [comment](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#comment) "Not classified as either local interneuron (CL:0004001) or projection neuron (CL:0020139), because the evidence differs between the cortical and striatal members of this class. Cerebral cortex: these cells are projection neurons. Long-range cortical GABAergic neurons identified by retrograde labelling are mostly somatostatin-, NPY- and nNOS-positive and lie in layer II, layer VI and white matter (PMID:15845086). The transcriptomic Sst-Chodl type was matched to these Nos1-positive long-range projecting cells by marker expression, location and Cre-line labelling, not by retrograde labelling of transcriptomically typed cells (PMID:26727548, PMID:27618674, PMID:30382198); Patch-seq maps the deep-layer, non-Martinotti, long-range projecting Sst-MET-1 type to Sst Chodl (PMID:33186530). Direct evidence comes from single-cell reconstructions of Sst;Chodl intersectionally labelled mouse cells, which have dense local arbors plus intracortical, mainly ipsilateral axons extending millimetres across most neocortical areas (PMID:42717094); see also PMID:40997796. Striatum: Sst-Chodl cells correspond to the Sst/Npy/Nos1 low-threshold spiking interneurons, which are described as local interneurons whose processes stay within the striatum (PMID:34302742, PMID:40403704); no striatal Sst-Chodl projection outside the striatum has been reported. Region-specific subclasses can be classified as projection neuron (cortex) or local interneuron (striatum). The label keeps 'interneuron' to match existing usage and the WMB taxonomy (CCN20230722). The marker set NPY can identify the Human cell type sst chodl GABAergic interneuron in the neocortex with a confidence of 0.894026187 (NS-Forest FBeta value)."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [sublingual gland demilune acinar cell](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0020085) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A serous demilune cell that is part of the sublingual gland, forming crescent-shaped serous caps on predominantly mucous acini and draining into the acinar lumen via intercellular canaliculi. This cell contains electron-dense proteinaceous secretory granules, abundant rough endoplasmic reticulum, and a well-developed Golgi apparatus. In humans, serous elements in the sublingual gland are largely restricted to such demilunes, in contrast to the purely serous parotid acini (Riva et al., 1988); gamma-glutamyl transpeptidase enriches serous demilunes in human salivary glands (Shiozawa et al., 1993)."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

- [tonsil centroblast](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0020084) [definition](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000115) "A centroblast that is part of a germinal center dark zone of a palatine tonsil. Like all centroblasts it is a large, rapidly proliferating (Ki-67-positive) germinal center B cell of the dark zone that undergoes somatic hypermutation driven by activation-induced cytidine deaminase (AID/AICDA), is retained in the dark zone by high surface CXCR4 responding to CXCL12, and has low surface immunoglobulin and low CD83. It is the tonsil counterpart of the (lymph-node-scoped) centroblast term, paralleling the existing tonsil germinal center B cell class."^^[string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)
